jobs.title: Engineering Industrial Placement
jobs.description:
About the Role

At EDF, success is personal. We don’t define it – you do. Join our Engineering Industrial Placement and you’ll shape your future, your way – while helping Britain achieve net zero. This is your chance to learn from experts, grow your skills and make a real impact.  
  
"Electricity is such a vital component in everyone’s lives. It powers schools, businesses and hospitals, so I knew that if I did my placement within EDF then I would have a really large impact on society, and that made my placement a lot more fulfilling.” Priyanka, Science and Engineering Industrial Placement  
  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This 12-month placement offers a starting salary of £26,050 and the chance to work at one of our key nuclear sites. You’ll be part of a team that’s driving innovation and safety in the energy sector.  
  
You’ll gain hands-on experience in engineering projects that support nuclear safety and operations. With opportunities to get involved with various different groups, this placement offers a springboard into a rewarding career in energy.  
  
**What You’ll Experience**  
  
During your Engineering Industrial Placement, you’ll work within the Engineering Department at either Heysham 1 or 2. Past students have led projects to simplify operations, delivered mitigations in support of nuclear safety cases and worked with engineers to troubleshoot a number of live issues. They’ve also helped maintain condition monitoring programmes and produced reports underpinning equipment reliability.  
  
This placement offers practical learning in a professional environment, supported by experienced teams and mentors. You’ll apply academic knowledge to real industry contexts, with the opportunity to put your overalls on and go and have a look at the plant yourself, while completing degree-relevant modules and gaining insight into engineering within the energy sector.  
  
**Your Work Location**  
  
You’ll be based on site at either Heysham 1 or 2 Power Station (Lancashire), within the Engineering Department.  
  
**Who You Are**  
  
To be eligible for this EDF industrial placement, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a bachelor’s degree (2:2 or higher) in Engineering.  
  
It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility, we reserve the right in our decisions to give priority to those who already have the right to work in the UK.  
  
To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.  
  
**Pay, Benefits and Culture**  
  
Alongside a starting salary of at least £26,050 per annum and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.  
  
At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that’s unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it’s your journey, powered by us.  
  
Everyone is welcome at EDF; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities.  
  
As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.  
  
**Our Recruitment Process**  
  
We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.  
  
For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision-making, assessment technology and human review.  
  
Find out more by visiting: https://careers.edfenergy.com/articles/2025-8/AI-and-Automated-Decision-Making-in-Recruitment-at-EDF  
  
Join us and find your success at EDF.  
  
#SuccessIsPersonal #EDFcareers #LI-Onsite #DestinationNuclear #Heysham1 #Heysham2

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**About us**

We're a Manchester-based FinTech building a smarter way for tenants to pay rent. Our platform pays landlords the full rent on time and collects smaller instalments from tenants via Open Banking Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). We're a small, high-trust engineering team solving genuinely hard problems in payments, credit, and financial correctness — where getting the maths and the money movement exactly right matters.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to own features end-to-end across our .NET backend and React Native mobile client. You'll work close to the domain — instalment maths, double-entry ledgers, scheduled money movement, and third-party integrations with banking and identity providers. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership and influence over architecture.

**What you'll work with**

* **Backend:** .NET 10 / C#, EF Core (SQL Server), a service-oriented solution with clean domain boundaries
* **Async & messaging:** MassTransit, background workers, durable/idempotent scheduled jobs
* **Cloud & platform:** Azure, .NET Aspire, containerised services
* **Mobile:** Expo / React Native (TypeScript)
* **Integrations:** Open Banking, VRP, BaaS, identity verification, credit decisioning
* **Practices:** ADR-driven architecture, EF Core migrations, automated testing (MSTest, NSubstitute, FluentAssertions)

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship features spanning the C# backend and the React Native app
* Model financial domains carefully — money, fees, timing differences, ledgers — where precision is non-negotiable
* Build resilient, idempotent background processing for payment execution and scheduling
* Integrate with external banking, payments, and identity providers
* Contribute to architectural decisions

**What we are looking for**

* Strong commercial experience with **C# / .NET** and modern **TypeScript**
* **Solid EF Core** / relational database skills (SQL Server ideal)
* Experience building and consuming APIs, and working with asynchronous/message-based systems
* **React Native (Expo)** experience, or strong React skills and appetite to work across mobile
* A pragmatic, quality-first mindset — you care about correctness, testing, and clear design
* Bonus: FinTech / payments / Open Banking experience, cloud (Azure), event-driven architecture

**Benefits**

* £65k–£85k salary depending on experience
* Hybrid working from our Manchester office
* 25 days holiday + bank holidays
* Pension, and the chance to shape a product (and a team) from an early stage
* Meaningful ownership and a direct line to the impact of your work
* **Sound like you?** Apply with your CV and a short note on something you've built that you're proud of.

Pay: £65,000.00-£85,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Manchester, Greater Manchester: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you now or in the future require sponsorship for a work visa?
* What are your base salary expectations?

Experience:

* C#: 5 years (required)
* React Native: 2 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Manchester

jobs.title: Senior C++ Engineer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Senior C++ Engineer** to join our team in London, United Kingdom in a hybrid working mode. You will be part of a high-performing team developing a global derivatives algorithmic trading platform. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with technologists, quants, and traders, optimizing proprietary trading technology for market-leading performance and reliability. You will contribute to the full stack, from venue connectivity to trading engines, in an open and collaborative environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop software that communicates with exchanges via APIs, handling market data and order transmission using protocols such as FIX, Websocket, or HTTP
* Ensure software quality by utilizing, maintaining, and extending testing suites
* Optimize exchange communication through kernel bypass and connection handling
* Research exchange behavior to align platform operations
* Implement solutions using exchange SDKs in C++, Rust, Python, and TypeScript
* Implement trading algorithms based on requirements from traders and quants
* Translate trading requirements into robust software implementations
* Improve stability, reliability, and performance of the trading engine
* Enhance monitoring and observability in partnership with Trading Operations
* Investigate and resolve production issues, including crashes and performance bottlenecks
* Prepare for releases and deployments of new trading engine versions

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years post-graduation professional C++ software development experience in the financial industry
* Solid understanding of parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming for distributed systems
* Good knowledge of algorithms and data structures
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Understanding of trading lifecycle, including order capture, execution, allocation workflow, settlement, and compliance
* Technical skills in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, C#, SQL
* Proven track record in application deployment best practices
* Experience in proactive system monitoring and troubleshooting

**Nice to have**

* Excellent communication skills for interaction with traders, developers, and stakeholders
* Ability to thrive in high-pressure trading room environments
* Experience working under demanding deadlines with changing priorities
* Experience in commodity trading and supply operations, ideally within the energy sector

**We offer**

* EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Protection benefits including life assurance, income protection and critical illness cover
* Private medical insurance and dental care
* Employee Assistance Program
* Competitive group pension plan
* Cyclescheme, Techscheme and season ticket loans
* Various perks such as free Wednesday lunch in-office, on-site massages and regular social events
* Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses
* If otherwise eligible, participation in the discretionary annual bonus program
* If otherwise eligible and hired into a qualifying level, participation in the discretionary Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program
